handoff: AC1–AC3 met and tested (repo lint + help tree); D12 exceptions untouched; checks and typecheck green. Nit: the retro skill's trace location is hard to find. AC4 (Release note, D13) is owed at the story pr step.

findings.title: The retro skill's trace location is hard to find
findings.detail:
'`<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl` files in the delivery tool's folder for this checkout, under your home directory (named after the checkout's folder)' does not give a path pattern, so an agent has to search the home directory. Keeping retro unaware of norn (P7) is deliberate, so this is a nit only.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally give a glob such as `~/.*/repos/<checkout folder>-*/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl`.

findings.title: The release note is still owed at the story's pr step
findings.detail:
AC4/D13: 'The story's PR description carries a "Release note" paragraph'. There is no pr.md on this branch yet, so the slice cannot carry it. This is not a defect in the slice, but the story's pr step must write the paragraph and the person must check it at ready.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Carry it forward in the handoff for the story pr step.
